Lopatyn Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Lviv Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. This record contains a contradiction worth flagging: it is categorized as demolished, yet the source's demolished field marks it as 'no.' Lopatyn's Jewish community, first settled in the early 19th century, supported two synagogues representing Belz and Husiatyn Hasidism by the late 19th century, along with a Bikur Holim society and Hevra Kadisha. On October 22, 1942, around 400 Jews were deported to the Sokal ghetto and later to the Bełżec death camp; only five Jews returned to Lopatyn on April 3, 1944.
